CustomField.description: Prompt tokens billed at full rate, summed across every model callout the run made. Cache-read tokens are NOT in this number and are carried separately, because they bill at roughly a tenth and adding them would make a cheap run look expensive. Written by: Receipt, summed from the provider's own usage block. Read by: nobody in the pass - TELEMETRY IS OBSERVATION AND NO BRANCH MAY READ IT, so a number that is wrong can never be a run that is wrong.
CustomField.label: Input Tokens
